distinguishing_fact: The articles are wrap-around clamping clips bent around wire edges rather than piercing/driven fasteners (staples/nails), rivets, threaded fasteners, or other similar articles of subheading 7616.10.
reasoning: The merchandise consists of stamped 5052-H36 aluminum alloy fastening clips used in aquaculture to assemble lobster wire traps. Subheading 7616.10 covers nails, tacks, staples, screws, bolts, nuts, rivets, cotters, cotter pins, and similar articles.
